# Black & Gold Dispatch

> Unofficial Pittsburgh Steelers fan news hub and sports-data utility. Headlines and links to original publishers, our own short summaries, and structured Steelers data (injuries, depth chart, schedule, stats, player grades, rumors with source reliability). Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by the Pittsburgh Steelers or the NFL. Updated about every 10 minutes.

Unofficial fan site. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by the Pittsburgh Steelers or the NFL.

Usage and attribution: Unofficial fan site. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by the Pittsburgh Steelers or the NFL. Headlines and links belong to their original publishers; we grant no rights in them. Summaries, grades, ratings, rumor tiers, needs and board rankings and analysis are written by Black & Gold Dispatch: credit 'Black & Gold Dispatch' and link to the original publisher (the `url` field). Scores, schedule, stats, depth chart, injuries and the stats behind stats-based grades come from nflverse (https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data), licensed CC-BY 4.0: you may reuse them if you credit 'Data: nflverse (CC-BY 4.0)'. College prospect stats come from CollegeFootballData.com (https://collegefootballdata.com): credit 'Data: CollegeFootballData.com'; we grant no rights in their data. Wikipedia-derived facts are CC BY-SA 4.0 (credit Wikipedia). Social posts are not reproduced; follow the link to the author. Do not republish full articles.

Data credits: Data: nflverse (CC-BY 4.0), https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data: schedule, scores, stats and ranks, depth chart, rosters, injury report. Updated by nflverse daily (mostly overnight). Reuse requires the same credit.

Legal (drafts pending attorney review): https://blackandgolddispatch.com/legal/terms.html · https://blackandgolddispatch.com/legal/privacy.html · https://blackandgolddispatch.com/legal/dmca.html

## Data (JSON API, versioned)
- [API index](https://blackandgolddispatch.com/api/v1/index.json): every dataset with counts and update times
- [OpenAPI spec](https://blackandgolddispatch.com/api/v1/openapi.json)
- [news](https://blackandgolddispatch.com/api/v1/news.json): Steelers headlines from beat writers, national outlets and blogs, with our one-line summaries and links to the publisher.
- [rumors](https://blackandgolddispatch.com/api/v1/rumors.json): Today's Steelers rumors (US Eastern day) with source reliability tier, status (Rumor/Confirmed/Denied), first-seen/updated times and consensus (independent sources, highest tier).
- [injuries](https://blackandgolddispatch.com/api/v1/injuries.json): Current Steelers injury designations from the official NFL injury report and reserve lists (nflverse, CC-BY 4.0): status and injury.
- [depth-chart](https://blackandgolddispatch.com/api/v1/depth-chart.json): Steelers depth chart by unit and position, 1st/2nd/3rd string with injury tags (nflverse, CC-BY 4.0).
- [schedule](https://blackandgolddispatch.com/api/v1/schedule.json): Steelers season schedule and results (nflverse, CC-BY 4.0).
- [stats](https://blackandgolddispatch.com/api/v1/stats.json): Steelers team stats with league ranks, and player stats (nflverse, CC-BY 4.0).
- [grades](https://blackandgolddispatch.com/api/v1/grades.json): Per-game player grades: transparent stats grade from the box score until 25 fan votes, then fan grade.
- [college](https://blackandgolddispatch.com/api/v1/college.json): College prospects at the Steelers' top needs with last-game and season stats (CollegeFootballData.com) and recent headlines.
- [insiders](https://blackandgolddispatch.com/api/v1/insiders.json): Last 3 days of public posts from NFL insiders and Steelers beat writers (links only).
- [podcasts](https://blackandgolddispatch.com/api/v1/podcasts.json): Today's Steelers podcast episodes and YouTube videos (links).
- [film](https://blackandgolddispatch.com/api/v1/film.json): Film breakdowns of the last game and previews of the next game (links).
- [draft](https://blackandgolddispatch.com/api/v1/draft.json): Steelers draft hub: top prospects per need with our estimated chance each is available at the Steelers' projected picks, published analyst grades of the last class (letter + link), and every past Steelers pick (nflverse, CC-BY 4.0).

_Availability method (estimate): Estimate, not a prediction: a prospect's real draft slot ~ Normal(mean = our board rank, sd = (4 + 0.30*rank) * position factor).
Chance he is still there at pick k = P(slot > k-1) = 1 - Phi((k - 0.5 - rank) / sd). Position factor widens the spread for positions
whose draft range is historically less predictable (QB 1.25; RB/LB/S/IOL/TE 1.10; others 1.0)._

# Steelers Opponent Preview

_Generated 2026-10-19T23:25:57+00:00 by Black & Gold Dispatch (unofficial fan site). Data updated: 2026-10-19T23:25:49+00:00._

Week 7: Steelers at **New Orleans Saints** (NO 2-4), kickoff 2026-10-25 13:30 UTC, Stade de France.

Last 5: NO W 24-17 @ BAL L 35-27 vs LV L 45-24 vs ATL L 23-13 vs MIN W 34-27 @ NYG; PIT L 20-3 @ NE W 30-27 vs CIN L 27-24 @ CLE W 34-22 vs IND W 26-19 @ TB

## 3 keys to a Steelers win
1. **Win the turnover battle**: Pittsburgh takes the ball away 1.67 times a game (5th); the Saints give it away 2.00 times (28th). Extra possessions could decide it.
2. **Keep the quarterback clean**: The Saints average 2.50 sacks a game (12th); Pittsburgh allows 3.17 (28th). Quick throws and solid protection matter.
3. **Lean on the run game**: Pittsburgh runs for 99.2 yards a game (20th), and the Saints give up 138.0 on the ground (30th). Staying with the run keeps the offense on schedule.

## 3 key matchups
1. **Jaylen Warren vs. the Saints' run defense**: Jaylen Warren carries the Steelers' ground game into a run defense that has had its problems. (Jaylen Warren: 84 carries, 460 yds (5.5 per carry); NO allows 138.0 rush yds/game (30th), 4.79 per carry)
2. **Chris Olave vs. the Steelers' secondary**: Chris Olave is the Saints' go-to target; slowing him down is job one for the back end. (Chris Olave: 43 catches, 580 yds, 2 TD (2nd in rec yds among WR/TE); PIT allows 204.3 pass yds/game (8th))
3. **Chase Young vs. the Steelers' offensive line**: Chase Young is the Saints' top pass rusher; Pittsburgh's line has to keep him away from the quarterback. (Chase Young: 5.5 sacks (3rd in NFL), 9 QB hits; PIT allows 3.17 sacks/game (28th))
